about: Ground truth for measureFacts (PLAN.md WP-2.2): 20 migrated clips whose expected facts come from sources independent of the code under test, at the pinned origins. Speeds: my-3d2dge-2's asset manifest, which measured each GLB clip's root speed in m/s (converted with the UAL rest's H0, 916.7 mm), for every Universal Animation Library loop that steps forward (Walk, Walk_Formal, Walk_Carry, Jog, Sprint, Crouch_Fwd, Zombie_Walk, Push), and shardfall's importer for 100STYLE's fastest and slowest recorded walks; the clips are in place, so measureFacts reads the speed from the planted feet. Distances: the same manifest for the six _RM clips and the three root-motion sword strikes (the root's horizontal distance). Strikes: the hero skills' strike times, which my-3d2dge-2's designers tuned against these clips (monster skills are left out: they also drive procedural creatures). Loop flags: the manifest's and shardfall's; a loop's seam must be small (a one-shot may also end where it began, so nothing is required of it).

tolerance.loop: a loop's seam at most 40 mm
